dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing initiating from the maximum width at the mid-body and tapering to a point at the visible posterior extremity.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-grey median pixel intensity across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse clusters of darker grey pixels distributed across the dorsal surface, particularly concentrated on the posterior half.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the primary grey baseline and localized darker mottled patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Discrete, small dark punctate marks observed on the posterior dorsal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark circular aperture at the anterior end consistent with a blowhole, and a distinct linear longitudinal ridge on the posterior dorsal midline.
